kwl_home_a_woman.text: Peedie means small in Orkney. A peedie cat, a peedie cake, a peedie problem. Nothing is large here but the sky.
In midsummer it never gets properly dark. Up in Shetland they call that twilight the simmer dim, and we know just what they mean.
Haarlings drift in with the sea fog, which we call the haar. Keep your voice down. They are very sensitive.
